Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files and appending extensions (.lockfile for LockFile)
Side-loading malicious dynamic-link libraries to disrupt endpoint protection (AtomSilo)
Exploiting vulnerabilities (ProxyShell, PetitPotam for LockFile; Confluence Server and Data Center bug for AtomSilo)
Discoverer: RE - CERT malware analyst Jiří Vinopal
Impacted Systems: Confluence Server and Data Center servers (AtomSilo)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched servers vulnerable to ProxyShell and PetitPotam (LockFile)
Exploitation of patched and actively exploited Confluence Server and Data Center bug (AtomSilo)
